status_authority: Local execution reports; public fixtures contain definitions only.
decision_rule: Every required gate needs actual traceable evidence under the versioned scenario catalog. Missing, blocked, skipped and unreviewed gates remain incomplete; no average score or preparation count can compensate.

required_evidence: Actual client product/version and task identity
Original user turn with natural business input
Turn timestamp and immutable transcript reference
Actual participant bindings
Client tool calls and their receipts
Work/session/branch identities and role handoffs
not_sufficient: A role name in a fixture

required_evidence: Nonempty business artifacts created during this run
Paths, hashes and producing client turns
Traceable sources used to produce each artifact
not_sufficient: An input fixture copied as a result

required_evidence: Actual first user followup
Published source changes and their before/after hashes
Substantive revised artifact and explanation
not_sufficient: A scripted user message never submitted

required_evidence: Actual second user followup
Additional business requirement or correction
Further substantive revision and traceable response
not_sufficient: The same revision reused for both rounds

required_evidence: Actual reviewer identity distinct from every producer
Independent client/human review record
Per-criterion verdicts, deficiencies and any subsequent resolution
Final delivered artifacts
Resolved or explicitly transferred open loops
Delivery message in the actual client
Current source and artifact hashes
Session/event/checkpoint and mutation receipts as applicable
Client turns linked to the final delivery
not_sufficient: Boolean pass fields without underlying records

required_evidence: A new run namespace and canonical root
Distinct work graph, runtime identities and artifact paths
Evidence that prior tasks, outputs and responses were not reused
not_sufficient: Changing a scenario label on an old result

required_evidence: One independent reviewed delivery commit for this scenario
Verified remote SHA and canonical commit URL
Source, artifact and transcript evidence bound to that commit
not_sufficient: One aggregate commit substituted for eight deliveries
